highlights_headline: Upcoming changes add CPU and ANGLE-backed GPU controls for modern .NET UWP applications.
highlights_body: The new UWP views use Windows.UI.Xaml and distinct UWP packages while sharing rendering implementation with WinUI. This does not restore legacy uap10.0 support.

bullets.detail: SkiaSharp.Views.UWP targets net10.0-windows10.0.26100.0 with a declared Windows minimum of 10.0.17763.0. SkiaSharp.NativeAssets.UWP supplies ANGLE and the UWP helper for win-x86, win-x64 and win-arm64, reusing Win32 Skia and HarfBuzz binaries. The documented XAML build and deployment workflow requires Visual Studio 2026 MSBuild; this is not Store-certification evidence.

SKXamlCanvas provides CPU drawing and SKSwapChainPanel provides ANGLE-backed GPU drawing, with UWP extensions and PaintSurface event arguments. Surfaces are control-managed: the CPU surface is disposed after the callback, and GPU resources are released with the context. DPI tracking falls back to DisplayInformation when XamlRoot is unavailable.

contributor_summaries.FoggyFinder: Modern .NET UWP controls, native integration and packaged CPU/GPU drawing samples.
